title: 每隔 n 个顾客打折
summary: 设计收银系统，按商品单价计算账单，并对每第 n 位顾客应用固定百分比折扣。
insight: 用哈希表保存商品价格、计数器记录已结账次数；只有计数能被 n 整除时乘折扣系数。
pitfalls: 顾客计数在每次 getBill 时增加

solutions.title: 价格表与订单计数
solutions.idea: 查询商品价格求和后按订单序号决定是否折扣。
steps: 构造时建立 product 到 price 的映射
getBill 中累加 price[product[i]]*amount[i] 并增加 counter

code.java: class Cashier { private final int n,discount;private int counter=0;private final Map<Integer,Integer> prices=new HashMap<>();public Cashier(int n,int discount,int[] products,int[] values){this.n=n;this.discount=discount;for(int i=0;i<products.length;i++)prices.put(products[i],values[i]);}public double getBill(int[] product,int[] amount){double total=0;for(int i=0;i<product.length;i++)total+=prices.get(product[i])*amount[i];counter++;return counter%n==0?total*(100-discount)/100.0:total;} }
code.kotlin: class Cashier(private val n:Int,private val discount:Int,products:IntArray,values:IntArray){private var counter=0;private val prices=products.indices.associate{products[it] to values[it]};fun getBill(product:IntArray,amount:IntArray):Double{var total=0.0;for(i in product.indices)total+=prices.getValue(product[i])*amount[i];counter++;return if(counter%n==0)total*(100-discount)/100.0 else total}}
code.cpp: class Cashier { int n,discount,counter=0;unordered_map<int,int> prices;public:Cashier(int n,int discount,vector<int>& products,vector<int>& values):n(n),discount(discount){for(int i=0;i<(int)products.size();++i)prices[products[i]]=values[i];}double getBill(vector<int> product,vector<int> amount){double total=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)product.size();++i)total+=prices[product[i]]*amount[i];++counter;return counter%n==0?total*(100-discount)/100.0:total;} };
